source_role_policy: Every measured main and authored Gleam/Erlang helper in the original compiler inventory counts. Generated Erlang/abstract forms/BEAM and pinned generic standard-library/runtime implementations are retained as provenance and excluded from authored source. No stream-launcher exclusion applies to clbg_runner.
owner_policy: Preserve imports, types/constructors, semantic FFI annotation and signature separately, function/control/arm/callback headers, every independent binding/effect/value body, actual written closes and data wrapping. Only the proved containing value prefix shares its first directly nested callback/control header. Further callbacks and every callback body/close remain independent. Count is the retained event-unit sum, never physical LOC fallback.

clbg_io.gleam.owner_review: Thirteen actual external annotations and thirteen typed signatures; byte I/O, numeric formatting/conversion and sqrt/byte/size/slice services. No benchmark loop or hidden callback executor.

clbg_reference.gleam.owner_review: One opaque Reference type, one make_ref annotation and one typed new signature. Main tree constructors/checks remain counted.

clbg_process.gleam.owner_review: One Task type and two external annotation/signature pairs. Typed callback ownership and join only; each authored callback body remains in its main source.

clbg_vector.gleam.owner_review: One Vector type and four external annotation/signature pairs. General tuple conversion/get/set; permutation/body algorithms stay authored in Gleam.

clbg_regex.gleam.owner_review: One Pattern type and two external annotation/signature pairs. General compile/search services only. Count/replace/substitution/control/output remain in each main.

clbg_io_ffi.erl.owner_review: Two directives; argument7; read_all/0 three; read_all/2 eight; write three; text/decimal/join/bytes two each. All case/receive arm headers, port-close match and actual end are independent. Tuple/list/formal punctuation is structural.

clbg_process_ffi.erl.owner_review: Two directives; start seven, join twelve. Owner/Tag bindings retain units; initializer+first fun header composes once, send and end stay separate. clbg_regex_ffi.erl.owner_review: Two directives; compile three; search nine. Successful compile match/return separate; search case, all three arm headers/bodies and actual end counted. PCRE2 is generic library provenance.

clbg_vector_ffi.erl.owner_review: Two directives and two function header/body pairs. No scalar-definition waiver hides get/set bodies.

clbg_runner.erl.owner_review: Two directives, main header, selected one-expression try header, success arm/halt body, catch arm, error-output and failure-halt bodies, actual end. This authored dispatcher is in every scored compiler bundle and fully counted.

gleam-fannkuchredux-optimized.owner_review: Same full permutation/flip bodies plus launch partitions and independent start/fold callbacks. The nested max case within fold stays a control owner; all callable/control closes counted.

semantic_prefixes.explanation: Complete local body is one literal list of nine strings, no binding/call/control/panic/callback. Its function header/body/close remain three separate units. Only the containing call prefix shares its first direct callback header.

sources is the already initialized local literal List(String). Actual take/take_loop use count cases, list patterns, recursive accumulation and generic reverse; no callback/effect operand is executed before the authored callback. Whole main, local patterns body and nested task callback remain counted.
Actual drop is count/list case recursion over the already constructed sources value. It has no callback/effect operand. Original authored callback header/count body/close remain independent.

Actual zip/zip_loop pattern-match both lists, recursively accumulate tuples and reverse. sources is List(String); counts is the independently counted append of joined Task(Int) results and local Int results, as qualified by the unchanged typed compiler bundle. No uncounted effect or callable body enters this value prefix. Callback output and close remain separate.
